data.title: 冰堂美智留 · 演出后台走廊的搭肩贴耳私语
data.description: 演出结束喧嚣未平的后台走廊里，挂着毛巾满身热气的美智留一把搂过你的肩膀，整个人几乎贴在你胸口。少女眼角泪痣散发着极致诱惑，在你耳畔吐气如兰：“喂……今天的我帅不帅？”
data.location: dimly lit music livehouse backstage corridor with sound equipment
data.action: slinging arm around partner shoulder, leaning close to whisper in his ear, sweating lightly after performance with sparkling violet eyes and beauty mark
data.lighting: moody colored backstage stage lights with atmospheric neon glow
data.mood: electrifying rockstar energy, bold childhood friend flirtation, breathless proximity
data.promptProse: In a neon livehouse backstage, sweaty Michiru Hyoudou leans close against partner ear, whispering with sparkling violet eyes and a beauty mark smirk.
data.animaCaption: Michiru Hyoudou whispering teasingly into partner ear backstage.
